6320.title: Runtime SDK dependencies incorrectly normalized as development-only
6320.rootCauseOneLine: The SDK manifest planner unconditionally moves runtime dependencies to devDependencies; its dry-run accepts the resulting layout even when host runtime imports cannot build.
6320.proposedFix: Honor the builder's runtime SDK dependency exception in the shared check/write placement policy, with runtime-import and stub-only regression coverage.
6320.caveats: Production omission was constructed from the trusted installer's policy without an external Git/npm install. Complete script and both clean-run outputs are inline. No PR: dependency packaging is outside this rule's simple-fix allowance.
